company_overview.name: BookLeaf Publishing
company_overview.description: BookLeaf Publishing is a premier self-publishing company operating in India and the US, processing 1,200+ books monthly across a catalog of 22,000+ titles.

packages.name: Standard Free
packages.details: No upfront cost; standard publishing and distribution.

packages.name: Bestseller Breakthrough
packages.details: Premium, paid package with specialized marketing and expanded distribution add-ons.

company_overview.facilities: In-house printing facility and warehouse located in Delhi.

royalty_policy.split: 80/20 split: 80% of net profit goes to author, 20% to BookLeaf.
royalty_policy.net_profit_formula: Net profit = MRP minus printing cost, platform commission (Amazon/Flipkart), and shipping charges.
royalty_policy.cycle: Royalties are calculated quarterly and paid within 45 days of the quarter ending.
royalty_policy.minimum_payout: ₹1,000 threshold. If accumulated royalties are below ₹1,000, they roll over to the next quarter.
royalty_policy.payout_method: Direct bank transfer to the account linked in the author's dashboard.
royalty_policy.transparency: Authors can view a detailed royalty breakdown in their dashboard, showing sales figures per platform.

isbn_policy.assignment: Every book published through BookLeaf receives a unique ISBN assigned by BookLeaf under BookLeaf's publisher imprint.
isbn_policy.custom_imprint: If an author wants an ISBN under their own imprint, they must obtain it independently.
isbn_policy.errors: If an author reports an ISBN error (duplicate, wrong book linked), it is treated as a high-priority issue and escalated to the production team immediately with a 48-hour resolution timeline.

printing_and_quality.fulfillment: In-house printing handles most orders; overflow or specific format requirements go to Repro India or Epitome Books.
printing_and_quality.turnaround: Standard print turnaround: 5–7 business days from order confirmation.
printing_and_quality.quality_defect_policy: If an author reports a quality issue (misprints, binding defects, color inconsistency), BookLeaf arranges a free reprint after verification. The author may need to share photos of the defective copy. Reprints take 5–7 business days.

distribution_and_availability.listing_turnaround: New listings typically go live within 7–10 business days after publication is complete.
distribution_and_availability.stock_sync_issue: If a book is showing as 'Currently Unavailable' on a platform, it usually indicates a stock sync issue. BookLeaf's team can trigger a re-sync within 24–48 hours for it to go live again.

production_stages.updates: Authors are updated at each stage via email.
production_stages.common_delay_bottlenecks: Cover Design (waiting for author approval) and Proofreading (revision rounds).

communication_tone_guidelines: Always empathetic and professional. Authors are our partners, not customers to be managed.
Acknowledge the author's concern before jumping to solutions.
Be specific: include actual numbers, dates, and statuses wherever possible rather than vague reassurances.
If something is BookLeaf's fault (delayed royalties, ISBN error), own it directly. No corporate deflection.
If the issue requires escalation or investigation, give a clear timeline ('Our team will look into this and get back to you within 48 hours') rather than open-ended promises.
Always end with a clear next step for the author and/or the BookLeaf team.

sample_calibrations.sample_query: I published my book 4 months ago and still haven’t received any royalty. What’s going on?
sample_calibrations.expected_guidance: Acknowledge the frustration. Explain the quarterly royalty cycle and 45-day payout window. Check if bank details are linked. Provide specific next payout date. If genuinely overdue, escalate with a 48-hour resolution timeline.

sample_calibrations.sample_query: My royalty amount seems too low. I sold 200 copies but only received ₹3,000.
sample_calibrations.expected_guidance: Explain net profit calculation: MRP minus printing, platform commission, and shipping. Offer to share a detailed line-by-line royalty breakdown. Don't be defensive—offer transparency.

sample_calibrations.sample_query: My book is showing a different ISBN on Amazon than what’s on the physical copy.
sample_calibrations.expected_guidance: Treat as high priority. Acknowledge this is a serious data issue. Confirm escalating to the production team immediately with a 48-hour resolution timeline.

sample_calibrations.sample_query: I received my author copies and the print quality is terrible. The images are blurry and pages are misaligned.
sample_calibrations.expected_guidance: Apologize sincerely. Ask the author to share photos of defective copies. Confirm BookLeaf will arrange a free reprint once verified. Provide 5–7 business days timeline for reprint.

sample_calibrations.sample_query: My book is published but it’s showing as 'Currently Unavailable' on Amazon.
sample_calibrations.expected_guidance: Explain stock sync issue. Confirm triggering a re-sync with distribution team. Set expectation: 24–48 hours for it to go live again.

sample_calibrations.sample_query: It’s been 3 weeks and my book is still in typesetting. When will it be done?
sample_calibrations.expected_guidance: Check actual production status. If delayed, be honest why. Provide specific updated timeline. Don't blame author even if delay is on their side—frame collaboratively.

sample_calibrations.sample_query: Can I update the description of my book on Amazon after it’s already live?
sample_calibrations.expected_guidance: Yes, metadata updates can be submitted through dashboard or by emailing BookLeaf team. Changes typically reflect on platforms within 3–5 business days.
